title: Jutsu Catalog
body:
Syntax: jutsu all

Shows every cataloged technique for your chosen combat class, including techniques not yet learned and their minimum levels. Shared general jutsu appear in a separate section. Immortal accounts see the full Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Genjutsu and Bukijutsu rosters plus shared jutsu. Conditional techniques are marked Release, Six Paths, or Scroll; levels alone do not guarantee they can be learned. Undiscovered scroll-only jutsu are not revealed to normal characters. The list is paginated (Enter for more, q to stop). 'skills' lists learned techniques. Every catalog row shows its one-word shortcut; type that shortcut directly or use jutsu shorts for a compact learned list.

Date: 2026-10-22
